briefing.headline: Anthropic and Google race to deploy agentic systems amid rising injection threats

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as frontier labs push multi-agent capabilities while regulatory scrutiny grows. Funding remains robust with major infra bets. DialectForge emerges as a protocol-level solution in security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus focused on long-horizon tasks; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 with native tool use. Meta and xAI accelerate open releases.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime defenses for agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Microsoft announces $15B hyperscale expansion in Europe; NVIDIA Blackwell clusters hit 100k GPU scale in multiple deployments.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols outpace safety alignment by 2027?
